translation.name: Pab tummad karta pab Jesucristobal igal-pin mezhijad

content: Jesús Zaqueo-neggin mas kuchad
Tegin Jesús Jericó-neg-kweburzhe tognonigu, ilagwen igalbal irmadmal.
Imi teun takalgu, Jericógin tule-walgwen-Zaqueo-nugad maimo. Tenal Zaqueodin Romano-tummadga-tulemalgin-mani-egwanmalad-e-tummadga mai, tegin tule-mani-ibedga maibal.
Imi Zaqueo Jesús-takpi-kudiin. Tenal Zaqueo tule-matu-choggu, al Jesús nasgu, Zaqueo tulemal-Jesúsbak-ichejul-irmamaidbal Jesús-kwen-takchajul-kus.
Al Zaqueo Jesús-iktual abarmad. Tegin Zaqueo Jesús-najoedgin sicómoro-chapigin nakwis Jesús-takegal.
Tenal Jesús Zaqueo-chiid inniki-kusgu, nikpa atad. Tegin Jesús Zaqueoga chogal: —Zaqueo, pe ilgwen aktema. Imis an pe-neggin keg-chulgu togenab.
Tegin Zaqueo chapi-akar ilgwen aktesgu, Jesúsbak mes aga e-negzhe nadzhun. Tegin Zaqueo weligwaledgin aga e-neggin Jesús-abingaszhun.
Tenal tulemal Jesús-takchagu, Zaqueo-neggin togzha, tulemal Jesús-uachogalmal: —Imi Jesús tule-iskana-neggin togzha.

Tenal Zaqueo Jesúsbak-pukwadgin kwisgusgu Tummad-Jesúsga chogal: —Tummad, an kakabo pega immal wis chogbido. Imi antin, an-immalmal-nikad an tule-wiledimaladga abal ukne. Tegin an-tulegin-immal-aturzhajad ilabakegwad-wilub an kannan nega uknebal.
Tegin Jesús Zaqueoga chogalzhun: —Imis-ibegin iti-neg-yaginmaladga tule-abonoleged noni. Imi pedin ampa Abraham-e-wagwaga kannan kunonibal.
Imi an-Te-Tule-Chunna iti-napche nonido, tule-Pabgin-nojadbal-oweles-kudimalad-amigal tegin we tulemal-abonomalgalbal.
Jesús purpal tule-tummad e-mosmalga ichejul-mani-ebejadgin chunmajad
Imi teun takalgu, Jesús Jerusalénzhe-omodanikidbal, tulemal ebinzhenatapmal Pab-neg-takmaid ilgwen noniko. Al tulemal ampa Jesús-itobukwadgin, Jesús purpal tulemalga chogal:
“Imi te ibagwengin tule-tummad mai. Tegin tule-tummad nap-pidzhe nejogalgu, erreyga nugzhalegal. Tenal we tule-tummad kannan akpirnonibalo.
“Tenal tule-tummad walambe e-mosmalzhe kocha. Tegin tule-tummad mosmal-ilbal yopí ichejul-mani ebes. Tegin tule-tummad e-mosmalga chogal: ‘Imi pemal we mani-ochanmamalo an kannan tanikoedzhe.’

“Tenal tulemal-e-neg-kweburginmalad istar we tummad-takmal. Al tule-tummad-naded-cholbal e-neg-kweburginmalad tulemal-palmis tummaganga choggal: ‘Imi anmal we tule-kwen-peichulmal anmal-erreyga kugal.’

“Tenal tule-tummad yabli erreyga nugzhales. Tegin tule-tummad kannan e-negzhe nonibal. Tegin tule-tummad e-mosmalga-mani-ebemaladzhe kocha. Tegin tule-tummad mosmal-ilbal ekichial melu ega mani-ochanmasmal-dewa.
“Tegin mos-kepe-inzhel-nonikid e-tummadga chognoni: ‘Tummad, pe-anka-mani-ebejad eg-ilambe an pega mani ochanmas.’
“Tegin errey e-mosga chogal: ‘Pe nued imas. Imi pe immal-totogwad yer akwis-choggu, al pe neg-kweburgan-kwaambe, pe tako.’
“Tegin mos-pid e-tummadzhe nonibalgu, chognonimo: ‘Tummad, pe-anka-mani-ebejad eg-ilatal an pega mani ochanmas.’
“Tegin errey e-mosga chogal: ‘Pe nued imas. Imi pe immal-totogwad yer akwis-choggu, al pe neg-kweburgan-kwaatal pe takmogo.’
“Tegin mos-pid erreyga chognonimo: ‘Tummad, wegin pe mani. Imi antin muswegin-ebirmakal pe-mani chabos.
Imi pe tule-puled-choggu, al an pe-tobgual. Imis an wisdo, pe kwen arpajul, tenal pe pinche kuakwa immal aminonida. Tegin pe immal kwen tigzhulbal, tenal pe immal weinonidabal.’

“Tegin errey e-mosga chogal: ‘¡Pe mos-iskanama! Imi pe aga tukin chunmajadbal, an chabzhul pe-imane. ¿Imi pe nued-wijiinzhulzhí, antin tule-puled? Imi an kwen arpajul, tenal an pinche kuakwa immal aminonida. Tegin an immal kwen tigzhulbal, tenal an immal weinonidabal.
Tede, ¿ibiga pe bancogin an-mani chaboszhuldé? Imi pe bancogin an-mani chabojalen, an kannan akpirijadgin bancogin anka mani ochanmajan.’
“Tegin errey tule-e-itobukmaladga chogalzhun: ‘Imi pe we tulegin an-mani chumalo, tule-ilambe-mani-ochanmajadga pe we mani ukmalo.’
“Tegin tule-itobukmalad erreyga chogalmal: ‘¿Ibigadé? Imi we tule mani-chogambe pato nika.’

“Tegin errey chogalbal: ‘Imi an pemalga chogdo: imi meke-ibi-tule ichejul immalmal nikal, we tulega pul-melu immal uklego. Tenal meke-ibi-tule iché immalmal nikal, we tulegin immal-ichegwad egwalenoniko, chunkal-kwabi kwichi-peio.
Tenal tulemal-anpak-istarmalad yapa erreyga an-odogusmalad, pe anka chedamalo, pemal an-wagin tar-mesmalgal.’ ” Teob Jesús chogzhagus.
Jesús errey-tummadyob Jerusalénzhe tognonikid
Tegin Jesús pél chunmasgu, tulemal-iktual nad Jerusalénzhe.
Tegin Jesús neg-kweburgan-Betfagé tegin Betania-omodanikidgin, Olivo-yal-inik peinoni. Tegin Jesús aga walbo e-chapingan-palmijogal neg-kweburzhe.

Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganga chogal: —Imi pe we neg-kwebur-toto-pe-takchiidzhe, pe nemalo. Tenal pe neg-kweburzhe tognatapil, pe taknatapmalo moli-burro-chapini edinal-un. Imi we moli-chapini tule ampa kwen nakwedijul. Tenal pe moli-burro-echikchal, pe anka chedamalo.
Tenal tule peje ekichialil: ‘¿Ibiga pe moli-burro-echiknai-wede?’ Pe we tulega chogo: ‘Tummadde choge ede we moli-pei.’
Tegin Jesús-e-chapingan-palmilesmalad Jesús-ka-chogzhad-yopí kus.
Teun Jesús-e-chapingan moli-echiknaidgin tule-moli-ibgan Jesús-e-chapinganzhe ekichialmal: —¿Ibiga pe moli-echiknanimal-wede?
Tegin Jesús-e-chapingan tule-moli-ibganga chogalmal: —Imi Tummad chog, ede we moli-pei. Tenal tule-moli-ibgan Jesús-e-chapinganga chogalmal: —Tegil pe cheddo.
Tegin e-chapingan Jesúszhe moli-cheinonimalgu, moli-yankalgin aga e-molmal okismal. Tegin e-chapingan moligin Jesús-onakwismalzhun.
Tegin Jesús moli-askin-chii natapidgin, tulemal errey-tummadyob Jesús-takedbal Jesús-iktual igalgin aga e-molmal okismal.
Tegin Jesús-Olivo-yal-odejogalidgin Jesús-e-chapingan-pel-kwapa ichejul-immal-taktijulmalad-takchamaladbal, weligwaledgin sapejul pulal Pab-Tummad-otummoalmal chogalmal:
Tegin Pariseomal-wal-walgwen-itobukmalad Jesúsga chogalmal: —Tule-oturdaked, pe-chapinganga pe chogma: ‘Melle weob kolmamal.’
Tegin Jesús Pariseomalga chogal: —Chulá. Imi an-chapingan yakir-pejalen, we akwamal kolmamaloen Pab-otummogal.
Tegin Jesús Jerusalén-omodanikidgin, panna Jerusalén takcha. Tegin Jesús tulemal-Jerusaléngin-pukmaladga peyedzhe poalzhun.
Tenal Jesús chogal: “Imi pemal yabli imis-ibegin wisguelen pe igi imakenabmal akalzhul ampagugal, pemal akalzhul ampagumaloen. Tenal imidin Pab aku-itogal pemal-imas-choggu, al pemal wisguszhulmal.

“Tenal pemalga kujal ibe-puled noniko. Tenal te ibegin tulemal-pebak-aichulmalad pel-kwapa pe-neg-kwebur ebirmalo. Tegin tulemal-pebak-aichulmalad pe-neg-kwebur ebirismalal, yalyob pel-kwapa ebiris nap omurmamalbalo, pe melle nomalgal.

Tenal tule-pebak-aichulmalad napkin-ebiogal pe-mesmalo, tegin nuskan-pukmalad ugakche-pakal. “Imi Pab pemalzhe-noni pemal-abonogal. Tenal pemaldin Pab-pemalga-immal-imabied akus takchamal. Al tule-pebak-aichulmalad pel-kwapa pebi neg eyarmalo, akwa-askin chii pel peiojul, ilgwen ubibi peio.”
Jesús Pabzhe-koled-neg-akar tulemal-immalmal-ukpukmalad-onijad
Tegin Jesús Pabzhe-koled-neg-impabal togzhagu, tulemal-immalmal-ukpukmalad-onis.
Tegin Jesús tule-immalmal-ukpukmaladga chogal: —Imi Pab Tummad kartagin chogdo:

Tegin Jesús pane-pane Pabzhe-koled-neggin Pab-igalgin tulemal-oturdadi-kus. Tenal tule-irwal-Pabzhe-kolmalad-e-tummagan tegin Moisés-igalgin-tulemal-oturdamalad tegin Judio-tummagan-pimalad igal-aminanimalan Jesús-mesgal.
Tenal tulemal yer Jesús-itosmaladbal Jesúsbak kudigusmal. Al Judio-tummagan kwen unniguszhulmal Jesús-mesgal.
